background_notes.justification: The time projection is continuous linear; the inverse image of the open interval (0,∞) is open. At a point of time r>0, continuity of that projection gives a neighborhood contained in Ω (for example impose time displacement less than r/2). Smoothness on an open domain is local and depends only on restriction to that domain, so the values of Uext outside Ω have no effect.
